create_passive_aggressive_classifier: create a PassiveAggressiveClassifier with hinge loss and custom aggressiveness parameter C
create_passive_aggressive_regressor: create a PassiveAggressiveRegressor with epsilon_insensitive loss and custom epsilon threshold
train_classifier_fit: train the PassiveAggressiveClassifier on labeled data using fit with optional warm-start initialization
train_regressor_fit: train the PassiveAggressiveRegressor on regression data using fit with optional coefficient initialization
incremental_fit_classifier: incrementally fit the PassiveAggressiveClassifier on subset data using partial_fit with class labels
